news.title: NLMC issues RFP to e-auction 11 government residential flats in Prayagraj
news.para: The National Land Monetization Corporation has unveiled a Request for Proposal for the auctioning of residential flats situated in three housing schemes throughout Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. The e-auction is set for December 11, following a pre-bid meeting on November 20. Those interested in participating should register and provide the Earnest Money Deposit by December 7. Further bidding details can be found on the specified e-auction portal.

news.title: Consumer panel directs Bombay Realty to  refund ₹1.95 crore to two homebuyers
news.para: In a significant ruling, the Maharashtra Consumer Commission has ordered Bombay Dyeing and Bombay Realty to reimburse homebuyers a total of Rs 1.95 crore. The commission noted that the developers did not meet the agreed-upon deadlines for flat delivery, highlighting a breach of service. Homebuyers from Jamshedpur encountered both delays and unreasonable financial requests.

news.title: Quick-commerce sector may require 75 million sq ft urban logistics space by 2030: Report
news.para: By 2030, India's quick-commerce sector is predicted to require around 75 million sq ft of urban logistics space. The expansion of dark stores is rapidly reaching tier-II and tier-III cities, indicating a significant growth in warehousing demand. As operators pursue partner-led models for optimization, this evolution will transform urban logistics landscape in India. It marks a critical shift in meeting the expanding needs of the market.

news.title: Green assets may account for nearly 75% of India's grade-A office stock by 2030: Report
news.para: By 2026, green-certified properties are anticipated to comprise about 70% of Grade A office supply in India, with Bengaluru and Delhi-NCR spearheading this green transformation. The rise in demand for sustainable workspaces is driving developers to consistently implement eco-friendly practices. Forecasts suggest that by 2030, green assets might represent nearly 75% of the entire office inventory across the nation.

news.title: India warehousing leasing rises 12% to 19.1 million sq ft in Q3 2026: Report
news.para: In the third quarter of 2026, India's warehousing leasing surged 12% year-on-year, reaching 19.1 million sq ft. Manufacturing and third-party logistics dominated, comprising 76% of the leasing activity. Chennai led the growth with an impressive 18% increase, totaling 2.7 million sq ft. Average rentals for warehousing climbed 3% to 5%, fueled by rising demand for Grade A facilities, indicating a shift towards more advanced logistics.

news.title: Karnataka's Somwarpet invites public input for master plan
news.para: The Karnataka government is undertaking an initiative to draft a comprehensive master plan for the Somwarpet planning area and is seeking public input until November 19. This strategic plan will gather information on both residential and commercial properties to facilitate organized development. The lack of such a framework has previously obstructed progress, affecting residents' livelihoods.

news.title: Homebuyer held defaulter cannot claim compensation from developer: Haryana RERA
news.para: A homebuyer from Greater Kailash-I faced issues with Ireo Grace Realtech regarding a delayed apartment project. The Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority ruled that the buyer was a defaulter and therefore could not claim compensation. The buyer stopped making payments due to construction delays, leading to the cancellation of the flat. Despite the difficulties, the authority held the builder partly liable for delays in obtaining the occupation certificate.

news.title: Nine months on, Kolkata civic body's panel may meet this week, decide on big realty projects
news.para: The KMC's municipal building committee is kicking off its meetings once again, ending an eight-month hiatus. This crucial step will allow for the approval of over 300 projects, including high-end residential developments. Real estate developers are optimistic that this revival will not only create jobs for construction laborers but also enhance KMC's income through associated building plan fees.

news.title: Delhi HC directs constitution of committee on demolition of dangerous buildings during GRAP restrictions
news.para: The Delhi High Court has mandated the Municipal Corporation of Delhi to establish a high-powered committee. This committee is tasked with tackling the repair, sealing, or demolition of hazardous buildings amidst GRAP restrictions. The court underscored the need to safeguard human lives from foreseeable threats, drawing attention to recent building collapses. Its directive aims for prompt action to avert future disasters.

news.title: BDA offers land ownership guarantee to over one lakh Bengaluru residents under amended law: CM
news.para: On the occasion of the Bangalore Development Authority's 50th anniversary, Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar revealed several initiatives aimed at benefiting the local populace. A significant aspect permits over one lakh residents to regularise homes built on acquired land with lower fees. Additionally, farmers who provided land for development will receive one acre of incentive site per property without facing litigation.

news.title: Paranjape Schemes targets ₹2,000 crore revenue in FY27; plans 2.5 million sq ft launches in H2
news.para: Paranjape Schemes expects revenue of around ₹2,000 crore in the current financial year, compared with ₹1,500 crore in the previous year, while maintaining blended profit margins of 20-21%. The company plans to launch around 2.5 million sq ft in the second half and reduce gross debt from ₹1,800 crore currently to about ₹700 crore by December 2027.

news.title: Bhu Bharati mess: Operator among four held for mutation fraud in Hyderabad's Kollur
news.para: Four individuals, including a Bhu Bharati operator, have been arrested for an illegal land transaction in Kollur. The incident involves a three-acre land worth over Rs 90 crores, leading to police action. The CID conducted a probe after complaints of irregularities in land mutation were reported. Officials suspect hacking of the Bhu Bharati portal to alter revenue records.

news.title: Hyderabad: 20-ft plot width restriction sparks protests; government eases permissions for old buildings
news.para: The enforcement of a long-standing regulation on small residential plots has sparked protests among citizens and developers. This regulation seeks to prevent unauthorized multi-storey constructions that have led to urban issues. Critics argue that the restrictions primarily impact economically weaker sections who cannot afford larger plots. Municipal officials have indicated that changes are underway to facilitate applications for reconstructing existing buildings.

news.title: Karnataka CM to review Bengaluru development body projects; regularisation fee cut
news.para: The Bangalore Development Authority is set to unveil an array of innovative projects and initiatives to Chief Minister DK Shivakumar. Among the highlights are plans for property regularisation, decreased charges for eligible residents, and an Absolute Sale Deed Mela targeting approximately 20,000 allottee sites. The agenda also features significant infrastructure enhancements, including new corridors and elevated roadways, aimed at streamlining application processing and project approvals in the near future.

news.title: West Bengal RERA's portal returns to life after two-month outage but backlog causes logjam
news.para: After a two-month hiatus, the West Bengal Real Estate Regulatory Authority website is up and running again. During the outage caused by a malware attack, developers struggled to register projects and submit crucial documents, leaving them unable to advertise or sell properties. The restoration of the portal brings renewed hope for developers looking to resolve their pending applications and restore stability to their operations.

news.title: Gera Developments expects FY27 revenue to rise 73% to ₹1,465 crore; gross margin seen at 24%
news.para: Gera Developments is forecasting a revenue boost of roughly 73% year-on-year, projecting a ₹1,465 crore for FY27. The company is committed to sustaining a 24% gross margin and a 12% EBITDA margin, despite the challenges of escalating construction costs. To combat this, they will adjust pricing on unsold properties.

news.title: Town planning department proposes 142 changes to DP for nine merged areas in Pune municipal limits
news.para: The state town planning department has announced 142 modifications to the Pune draft development plan, focusing on adjustments to road dimensions, alignments, and provisions for public amenities. These proposed changes are up for public review before being sent to the state government for approval. Residents are voicing their concerns about necessary amenities in light of rapid development, urging for adherence to the finalized plan to resolve current challenges.

news.title: RWAs should not charge house owners NOC fee for adding relatives’ names to property documents
news.para: Resident welfare associations and apartment owners' associations in Noida cannot charge fees for name additions. This decision stems from a case filed by Rajesh Sawhney regarding his children's names on property documents. The deputy registrar deemed the fee demand illogical since no monetary transaction is involved in these cases. Under the Uttar Pradesh Apartment Act, fees are applicable only during sales involving monetary transactions.

news.title: NBCC cancels bids for 49 luxury flats after declaring winners; buyers move HC
news.para: NBCC’s Avenue Towers project in Sarojini Nagar is facing legal challenges from disgruntled buyers in Delhi. Buyers have contested the abrupt cancellation of bids for 49 flats after they quoted the highest prices. The project features high-end apartments that have drawn significant interest due to their location and amenities. Officials cited administrative reasons for the cancellation, raising concerns over the auction's transparency.

news.title: Prestige Estates to buy Allure Developers for up to ₹523.76 crore; plans housing project in Noida
news.para: Prestige Estates Projects is making a big move by buying Allure Developers entirely for a price tag of up to ₹523.76 crore. This acquisition is part of their plan to kick off an exciting new residential project in Sector 150, Noida. It's an ambitious step aimed at enhancing their portfolio in the real estate market.
